audit.new_core_script: New core/*.xsh applets are installed by the release script at dev/release.xsh:146-160; dev/tests/test-repository-contracts.xsh owns the required core script inventory and contract checks. No separate command registration is needed.
audit.launcher_argument_separator: Use xsh SCRIPT -- ARGS for an applet and xsh -- SCRIPT ARGS for an explicit script; src/entrypoints/xsh.rs:90-120.
audit.stdlib_multi_file_modules: No: the embedded standard library catalog maps each identity to one source file, src/stdlib.rs:40-92 and src/loader.rs:751-818. Dotted user modules resolve through module roots, src/loader.rs:982-1020.
audit.pty_test_wiring: tests/core_compat_extra.rs:13-34 includes tests/core_compat_extra/pty.rs; Cargo.toml:157-165 declares core_compat_extra. The new applet invocation should use xsh core/btop.xsh -- ARGS.
audit.monotonic_clock: No public monotonic clock exists. time.now is wall-clock only, crates/xsh-registry/src/signature/docs.rs:1528-1531; G1 needs the smallest registry-backed monotonic API.

The public time.monotonic() API returns nondecreasing nanoseconds from a process-local Instant origin; the behavior test verifies advancement across a 2 ms wait, and the API test pins the duration-only contract.
The independent B3 counter literals produce 40.0% aggregate busy time.
A first CPU observation reports warming with no fabricated rate.
A complete idle interval reports 0.0% busy time.
The B3 process delta reports 12.5% of total-machine CPU.
The B3 process delta reports 25.0% under the per-core convention.
The rooted statm reader and page conversion produce 67,108,864 bytes from 16,384 pages at 4,096 bytes per page.
Equal rates sort by ascending PID with stable output order.
Exiting, appearing, and same-PID/new-start process instances warm independently.
Independent interface counter literals produce RX 10,240 B/s and TX 2,048 B/s.
An absent proc/net/dev source and an observed empty table retain different states.
Selection is name-sorted and chooses eth0 while skipping loopback.
The B3 memory counters produce 805,306,368 used bytes.
Observed zero swap counters remain distinct from absent swap fields.
Malformed meminfo values withhold only their field; valid neighbors remain available.
The rooted memory reader distinguishes observed zero from a missing counter.
Truncated proc/stat and meminfo reads expose no prefix values.
CPU, memory, network, and process values occupy their asserted positions at 80 by 24.
CPU, memory, network, and process values occupy their asserted positions at 120 by 40.
The renderer returns a safe minimum-size message below 80 by 24.
The real applet exits with status 2 and an unrecognized-option diagnostic.
Repeated replay decoding and model reduction produce identical values from the frozen B3 raw fixture.
Removing a frame source leaves it absent in the model instead of consulting the host.
The real headless replay applet completes under syscall tracing without a child-process or sleep syscall.
The PTY observes the warming frame, a resized redraw, the second rate update, q exit, restored termios, SGR reset, and cursor visibility.
The raw-mode PTY delivers Ctrl-C as a byte, exits successfully, and restores termios, SGR styling, and cursor visibility.
Syscall traces of rooted live-source collection and the real headless replay applet contain no child-process execution; replay also has no sleep syscall.
The shared meminfo parser keeps the system-report duplicate, malformed, range, and vendor-counter behavior; the full 133-test system-report suite passed.
The existing batch top path and neighboring procps sampling tools still pass their bounded-sample regression.

blocked.reason: The pinned Linux lane targets aarch64-unknown-linux-musl but this host is x86_64 and has no ARM64 binfmt handler; Docker returns Exec format error before tests start.
blocked.unblock_command: Run the same pinned lane on an ARM64 host or on a host with the repository-required ARM64 binfmt support, then compare final failures with the baseline.

contract_changes.name: time.monotonic
contract_changes.summary: Added a Result[Int, Error] monotonic nanosecond clock with process-local origin for elapsed-duration measurement; it is distinct from wall-clock time.now.

contract_changes.name: tui.cell_width/cell_clip/cell_slice/cell_left_pad/cell_right_pad/safe_single_line
contract_changes.summary: Added Unicode 16 cell-aware width, clipping, slicing, padding, and hostile single-line text sanitization helpers.

contract_changes.name: btop replay manifest schema 2
contract_changes.summary: Replay bundles now require recorded terminal capability inputs and dimensions; schema 1 is rejected so replay never guesses host display state.

contract_changes.name: unix.tty_mode(raw)
contract_changes.summary: Raw mode now disables echo, signal generation, extended processing, and input flow control consistently with the documented stty raw contract.
